verdict.rationale: The README documents in-agent marketplace install commands (`/plugin marketplace add kaankiziltug/logo-design-skill` then `/plugin install logo-design@logo-design-skill`). It also states that after starting a new session the agent picks up the skill from its description, which meets the active-next-session requirement. Manual folder-copy and upload paths exist as alternatives. Missing for 10: the install takes two commands (add marketplace, then install) rather than a true one-liner; no independent or hands-on corroboration that the install works as documented.
